question: which functional of the paired differences should the manuscript report, decided before the fold is read

comparison.arm_a: table field, compiled on the fit half only
comparison.population: pick half of a cluster-disjoint split of the training fold

procedure.power: fraction of subsamples whose 95% bootstrap interval excludes zero
procedure.shrink_model: the differences are shifted so the effect is a fraction of the pick-half one, spread unchanged; a range is swept rather than the published held-out margin plugged in, so that the choice is not conditioned on the number it will test
procedure.calibration: the same fraction after flipping the sign of each unit's difference at random, which must not exceed 0.08
procedure.stratification_covariate: chain length, known before either method is run
procedure.selection_rule: highest mean power over the shrink curve among calibrated candidates; ties within 0.02 go to the statistic whose claim asserts more. Point estimates are not compared across candidates because they are not on a common scale

candidates.claim: the field leads P2Rank on average by
on a typical structure the field leads P2Rank by
discounting the 10% tails, the field leads P2Rank by
discounting the 20% tails, the field leads P2Rank by
the field beats P2Rank on a fraction of structures exceeding one half by
holding chain length fixed, the field leads P2Rank on average by

preregistered.claim: discounting the 20% tails, the field leads P2Rank by

forecast.reading: the read is more likely than not to leave the interval across zero, and that outcome is predicted here rather than explained afterwards

commitment: the manuscript will report trimmed20 of the paired per-unit differences on the held-out fold, and the sentence it licenses is: discounting the 20% tails, the field leads P2Rank by ... . This was fixed before the fold was read for it.
the_mean_is_still_reported: the preregistered statistic is the one inference is drawn from, not a replacement for the mean. The mean of the paired differences stays in the manuscript beside it, because it is what the literature reports and because dropping the underpowered functional once a better-powered one is in hand is the same selection this file exists to prevent.
